entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or order inquiries, please stay on the line.
Yeah, yeah, a return. Just get me to a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Just give me a yes or no, can I do it? I don't have time for a long call.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number?
Alex Sterling. Order number is VF-881-209. So, can I return it?
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the Aero-X helmet, delivered 46 days ago. Is there a technical fault or is it a preference issue?
The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened. It's brand new.
Understood. Not a problem at all. Your item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can approve that return for you right now.
Finally. Good. Email me the label.

I've just sent that prepaid return label to the email on file. And I see you're a VIP member with us, Alex. For the inconvenience, and to make sure your next purchase is perfect, I've included a 20% loyalty discount in that same email. We want to ensure your safety and satisfaction.
Oh. Okay, a discount. That's actually useful. Thanks.
You're very welcome. As soon as we receive the helmet, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Alex. Have a good one.
